This article is an examination of that question, breaking down the sustainability pros and cons of AI use, so you can make informed decisions about the tools you use.

It once required JavaScript. Now we have scroll-driven animations in CSS, which is free from the main-thread blocking that can plague JavaScript animations. Bringing Back Parallax With Scroll-Driven CSS Animations originally published on CSS-Tricks, which is part of the DigitalOcean family. You should get the newsletter.
